action.content: For a bunch of students, write a 200+ word poem that professionally describes a new line of shoes. Make sure to use markdown to highlight/bold at least one section of the poem. Example: *highlighted text*
action.label: context

action.content:
In hallowed halls where youthful minds take flight,
A new collection brings a spark of light.
No longer bound by canvas or by lace,
These shoes are built to conquer every space.

Designed with precision, crafted for the run,
They offer comfort that the weary can't outdone.
The **ergonomic sole provides a cushioned embrace**,
Turning every step into a graceful race.

From lecture halls to late-night study sessions,
These sneakers offer endless, reliable lessons.
The breathable mesh allows the feet to breathe,
While the durable upper promises to never leave.

A sleek silhouette that complements the uniform,
It signals that the student is truly becoming.
Whether sprinting down the quad or walking slow,
This footwear makes the journey feel like home, you know.

With arch support that aligns the posture right,
They turn the longest day into a fleeting flight.
No blisters form, no pain can ever start,
As these premium shoes help every student's heart.

So lace them up and stride with confidence and grace,
For style and substance in this modern race.
A perfect blend of function and of form,
To help the student find their inner storm.||
